name: Fixed number of coin flips
setup: n fair coins are flipped; the question is about the joint outcome of a known number of flips.
levers: target count, tail event, parity, adjacency restriction, longest run, biased coin

name: Flip until something happens
setup: A coin is flipped repeatedly until a stopping condition; the number of flips is random.
levers: target pattern, bias, two patterns racing, stop on lead of k
aliases: flip until, waiting for a pattern

name: Lattice paths on a grid
setup: Unit steps right (R) and up (U) from (0,0) to (m,n).
levers: endpoint, diagonal barrier, forbidden point, required point, number of direction changes, step set
aliases: grid paths, moving on a grid, monotone paths

name: Dice sums
setup: One or more fair dice are rolled; questions about sums, maxima, or distinctness.
levers: number of dice, target sum, re-roll rule, stopping rule

name: Urn draws without replacement
setup: Balls of several colours are drawn from an urn without replacement.
levers: colours, stopping rule, what is being counted
aliases: urn, balls in a bag, deck of cards

name: Gambler's ruin
setup: A random walk on integers with absorbing barriers; a player bets until broke or at a target.
levers: bias p, barrier positions, ruin probability vs duration

name: Random permutations
setup: A uniformly random permutation or shuffle; questions about its structure.
aliases: hat check, shuffled deck, secret santa

name: Optimal stopping
setup: Observe values sequentially and decide when to stop; the decision rule is the answer.
levers: number of candidates, payoff, recall allowed
aliases: secretary problem, dice game with stopping

name: Geometric probability
setup: Points are chosen uniformly in a continuous region; probability is a ratio of areas or lengths.
levers: dimension, number of points, region shape
